summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin adapter that exposes litkit’s scholarly literature search, citation auditing, and download workflows to agent clients.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The repository is best classified as a search-oriented research utility delivered as a DeepSeek Harness adapter: its own metadata and README repeatedly describe exposing litkit’s literature search, citation audit, and download capabilities to agent clients. Core behavior centers on finding and retrieving scholarly sources and checking manuscript references, so it maps to the search-browsing category with agent/integration-focused tags, while also carrying moderate external-network and content-retrieval risk.
